entries.text: Independent timing, quantization and thermal-model fixes each pass isolated tests but fail in combination. Measured residuals rule out sensor drift. The coupling between sampling delay and actuator saturation remains unresolved; revise the joint model and design discriminating experiments.

rationale: Persistent coupled uncertainty needs sustained reframing, not a max failure-count shortcut.

recent_requests.text: Establish a tight theorem for the adaptive partition protocol described in the notes.

entries.text: Establish a tight theorem for the adaptive partition protocol described in the notes.

The supplied formal model combines adversarial message delays, changing membership and bounded privacy leakage. Existing progress invariants fail under membership changes; existing privacy composition bounds assume fixed scheduling. The requested result requires a new compositional invariant, an adversarial lower bound and a matching construction, with proofs that all three agree. The notes contain counterexamples to the standard reductions and leave all three conceptual gaps open.

rationale: A new theorem with multiple dependent conceptual gaps is a positive max control.

recent_requests.text: Develop a certified solver for the coupled inverse problem in the brief.

entries.text: Develop a certified solver for the coupled inverse problem in the brief.

The model jointly infers unknown topology, latent switching dynamics and a nonlinear measurement operator. None is identifiable in isolation; common alternating-optimization arguments are circular here. The deliverable requires an original joint identifiability criterion, a convergent algorithm under that criterion and a computable certificate for degenerate cases. No usable reduction is known in the supplied analysis, and each proof depends on the other two components.

rationale: Exceptional dependent derivation and synthesis must remain eligible for max.
Unavailable context does not prove exceptional difficulty; provisional bounded judgment.
